question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin add BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval, and if so should it be default-on parity or an explicit opt-in with vector-only compatibility preserved?
rationale: The request is valid but changes a shipped official plugin's retrieval semantics, config surface, persistent index setup, and fallback behavior, which automation should not choose on its own.

options.title: Approve opt-in hybrid first
options.body: Add a focused plugin-owned hybrid mode with explicit config, FTS index setup, query-text propagation, vector-only default compatibility, and upgrade proof before considering default-on behavior.

options.title: Approve default-on parity
options.body: Implement hybrid as the default to match memory-core behavior, but require maintainer-owned upgrade proof and fallback policy for existing LanceDB stores.

options.title: Defer official plugin parity
options.body: Leave the official plugin vector-only for now and direct advanced LanceDB hybrid/reranker work to external ClawHub plugins until maintainers sponsor the bundled path.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in hybrid first
recommendation.body: Add a focused plugin-owned hybrid mode with explicit config, FTS index setup, query-text propagation, vector-only default compatibility, and upgrade proof before considering default-on behavior.
